pairs: Act now, you who are wealthy!
plorate ululantes in miseriis vestris, quæ advenient vobis.
Weep and wail in your miseries, which will soon come upon you!
et vestimenta vestra a tineis comesta sunt.
and your garments have been eaten by moths.
Your gold and silver have rusted,
et ærugo eorum in testimonium vobis erit,
and their rust will be a testimony against you,
et manducabit carnes vestras sicut ignis.
and it will eat away at your flesh like fire.
Thesaurizastis vobis iram in novissimis diebus.
You have stored up wrath for yourselves unto the last days.
Ecce merces operariorum, qui messuerunt regiones vestras,
Consider the pay of the workers who reaped your fields:
it has been misappropriated by you;
clamat: et clamor eorum in aures Domini sabbaoth introivit.
it cries out. And their cry has entered into the ears of the Lord of hosts.
You have feasted upon the earth,
et in luxuriis enutristis corda vestra in die occisionis.
and you have nourished your hearts with luxuries, unto the day of slaughter.
and he did not resist you.
until the advent of the Lord.
Ecce agricola exspectat pretiosum fructum terræ,
Consider that the farmer anticipates the precious fruit of the earth,
patienter ferens donec accipiat temporaneum et serotinum.
waiting patiently, until he receives the early and the late rains.
you too should be patient and should strengthen your hearts.
For the advent of the Lord draws near.
do not complain against one another,
so that you may not be judged.
the judge stands before the door.
who spoke in the name of the Lord,
as an example of departing from evil,
prophetas qui locuti sunt in nomine Domini.
Consider that we beatify those who have endured.
You have heard of the patient suffering of Job.
And you have seen the end of the Lord,
nor by the earth, nor in any other oath.
But let your word ‘Yes’ be yes,
non: ut non sub judicio decidatis.
so that you may not fall under judgment.
Let him bring in the priests of the Church,
and let them pray over him,
ungentes eum oleo in nomine Domini:
anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.
And a prayer of faith will save the infirm,
and the Lord will alleviate him.
Therefore, confess your sins to one another,
et orate pro invicem ut salvemini:
and pray for one another, so that you may be saved.
multum enim valet deprecatio justi assidua.
For the unremitting prayer of a just person prevails over many things.
Elias homo erat similis nobis passibilis:
Elijah was a mortal man like us,
et oratione oravit ut non plueret super terram,
and in prayer he prayed that it would not rain upon the earth.
And it did not rain for three years
and the earth brought forth her fruit.
si quis ex vobis erraverit a veritate,
if anyone of you strays from the truth,
scire debet quoniam qui converti fecerit peccatorem ab errore viæ suæ, salvabit animam ejus a morte, et operiet multitudinem peccatorum.
he ought to know that whoever causes a sinner to be converted from the error of his ways will save his soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
